changelog:
- Initial release of grok-query skill.
- Enables real-time querying of Grok AI (grok.com) via browser automation.
- Requires the user to be pre-logged-in to Grok in an OpenClaw browser.
- Supports both single and multi-turn conversational research, including handling news, real-time info, and external knowledge verification.
- Includes robust error handling and step-by-step workflow for interacting with Grok’s web interface, including popup management and interface element detection.
- No SuperGrok subscription required; works with free-tier accounts.
